identity.title: Recreational Marijuana Producer License (OLCC) — Evergreen Botanicals, LLC, Bailey Hill

scan.summary: This is the OLCC's Recreational Marijuana Producer License authorizing Evergreen Botanicals, LLC to grow cannabis at its Bailey Hill premises under a Tier II indoor canopy limit. As the agency's own document, there is nothing in it to fix or draft — what matters to the licensee is meeting its five listed conditions and getting the annual renewal filed on time.
scan.freshness_note: The current term began March 3, 2026 and runs one year; this is a live, in-term license, not an old one.

conditions.title: Operate only at the named premises; no transfer of location or person
conditions.evidence_expected: Current premises diagram/address on file matching 2210 Bailey Hill Road; no record of relocation or ownership transfer without a new application

conditions.title: Renew annually; submit renewal application and fee at least 20 days before expiration
conditions.evidence_expected: Dated copy of renewal application (or CAMP submission confirmation) and proof of fee payment filed on or before February 10, 2027

conditions.title: Track all marijuana items in the Cannabis Tracking System (CTS) and ensure all handlers hold current marijuana worker permits
conditions.evidence_expected: CTS account records/reports and a roster of current, unexpired worker permits for every employee handling marijuana items

conditions.title: Maintain video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 with recordings kept at least 90 days
conditions.evidence_expected: Surveillance system logs, camera coverage diagram, and archived footage retention records covering at least a rolling 90-day period

conditions.title: Report any change in ownership, premises, or financial interest holders to OLCC before it takes effect
conditions.evidence_expected: Copies of any change-of-ownership or change-of-premises filings submitted to OLCC prior to the change

conditions.title: Display the license at the premises where the public can see it
conditions.evidence_expected: Photo or physical confirmation of the license posted at Bailey Hill in a publicly visible location

deadlines.source_line: A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence reading the license face fields verbatim from the document. I checked two of the specific numeric rules cited on the license — the 20-day renewal filing window and the 90-day video retention period — against current OLCC administrative rules and both match what is stated on the license. I could not verify the exact license number format against a live OLCC registry, so treat it as read-from-document only. Because this is the agency's own issued permit, there are no compliance gaps to flag; the only real risk is administrative — missing the renewal window or failing to meet the listed conditions.

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
